related_questions.question: Is Nasdaq 100 the same as Qqq?

text_blocks.snippet: No, the Nasdaq 100 is not the same as QQQ, but QQQ is an ETF that tracks the Nasdaq 100 index. The Nasdaq 100 is an index of the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq stock market. QQQ, also known as Invesco QQQ Trust, is an exchange-traded fund that aims to replicate the performance of the Nasdaq 100.

list.title: Nasdaq 100:
list.snippet: This is a stock market index, a benchmark that measures the performance of a specific group of stocks. In this case, it's the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq.

list.title: QQQ:
list.snippet: This is a specific ETF, an investment fund that trades on an exchange like a stock. The QQQ ETF is designed to track the performance of the Nasdaq 100 index.

text_blocks.snippet: So, when you buy shares of QQQ, you are essentially investing in a fund that holds the stocks of the companies in the Nasdaq 100 index, aiming to mirror the index's overall performance.
